name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
summary: The dataset is the current 4.927 km layout (2023+ straight along Raffles Avenue instead of the Float section, remeasured 2025) and follows the roads; direction, start line (5 m) and pit side are right. Missing: the East Coast Parkway / Benjamin Sheares Bridge viaduct and its ramps that the cars pass under around T1-T5 and before the line, and the building link over Raffles Boulevard. The pit lane limit has been 80 km/h since 2025 (game 60). Height range capped at 4 m vs 5.3 m published.

findings.game: nothing overhead anywhere on the lap
findings.real: the ECP / Benjamin Sheares Bridge viaduct and its ramps pass over the track at T1 (s ~200-260), around T3-T5 (s ~520-1020) and before the line (s ~4280-4340); a covered building link spans Raffles Boulevard (s 1236-1259, 4.5 m clearance)
findings.proposedFix: scenery: build road viaducts (OSM highway=* bridge=yes layer>=1 crossing the corridor) as decks on piers outside the corridor, deck underside from OSM / >= 6 m above the track; add building passages with min_height as slabs. Ways listed in covered.overTheTrack

findings.real: 60 km/h until 2024, 80 km/h from 2025 (the game's 4.927 km layout is the 2025 one; default season 2026)

overheadStructures.what: East Coast Parkway / Benjamin Sheares Bridge (motorway viaduct, layer 1-2) and its ramps

layout.dataset: 2023+ layout (en.wikipedia: 2025-present 4.927 km, 19 turns; 2023-2024 4.940 km). Seasons 2010-2022 used the Float section (5.065-5.073 km), not modelled

osm.method: map-matched to the public roads ignoring oneway (raced against the traffic in places); dual carriageways -> metres of offset are expected
osm.visualCheck: img/sg-2008-ov.png: the game line follows the circuit roads all the way

direction.evidence: anti-clockwise (REVERSED_IN_DATASET in build-tracks); lap description on en.wikipedia (T1 left, Republic Boulevard, Raffles Boulevard, ...) matches

osmFinishLine.note: tagged 2026-05 by one mapper; not checked further

pit.sideConvention: gameS < 0 = before the line; side as in tracks-data pitSide (-1 = driver's right)

limit.source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore_Grand_Prix (2025: "increase in the pit lane speed limit from 60 km/h to 80 km/h", ref. Pirelli press 2025-09-29 https://press.pirelli.com/managing-the-heat-under-the-lights-in-singapore/ — checked: "The increase in the pit lane speed limit from 60 to 80 km/h ...")

elevation.demSource: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (AWS open data COG https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N01_00_E103_00_DEM/Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N01_00_E103_00_DEM.tif)
elevation.demNote: GLO-30 along the game centreline (the map-matched OSM path detours round dual carriageways), "dsmflat" filter = 20th percentile over 300 m + Gaussian 80 m: dense city, buildings and the ECP viaduct are in the surface model, only the broad shape survives. SRTM (2000) does not fit the present ground (range 50 m) and is not used.
